companionBriefing: Portia only lets in people who greet her properly. Answer in Spanish; mixing in English is fine while you learn.
Tap a word under her line to see what it means, or Translate sentence for the whole line. On her newest line each one uses a hint from my allowance.
The words and phrases shown beneath her lines go into your Spellbook, where you can review them later.

steps.name: move to the_rift (expect NOT_ADJACENT)
steps.message: You can't get to The Rift from here.

steps.name: say "¡Hola!"
steps.feedback: Good greeting! Next, introduce yourself in Spanish, then ask Portia her name.

steps.name: say "Me llamo Sam."
steps.feedback: Your introduction is correct. Now ask Portia her name in Spanish.

steps.name: say "¿Y tú?"
steps.feedback: Correct! Your question naturally asks Portia to introduce herself.

lines.native: Bienvenido al mercado. A greeting and your name, please. I have standards, despite the masonry.
lines.translation: Welcome to the market. A greeting and your name, please. I have standards, despite the masonry.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from the archway’s keystone. Portia poises a pen with the gravity of a minor licensing authority.

lines.native: ¡Hola! Bienvenido al mercado. Greeting accepted. Your name is still missing from the visitors’ book. Who are you?
lines.translation: Hello! Welcome to the market. Greeting accepted. Your name is still missing from the visitors’ book. Who are you?
lines.narrative: Portia ticks a box in the visitors’ book. The archway remains firmly unwelcoming in a structural sense.

lines.native: Mucho gusto, Sam. Bienvenido al mercado. Your introduction is accepted. Any interest in whom you’re speaking to? I am not merely load-bearing.
lines.translation: Nice to meet you, Sam. Welcome to the market. Your introduction is accepted. Any interest in whom you’re speaking to? I am not merely load-bearing.
lines.narrative: Portia enters Sam in the visitors’ book. Her pen then hovers over a second column, labelled Courtesy Returned.

lines.native: Me llamo Portia. Mucho gusto, Sam. You asked! How exceptionally civil. I shall remember this courtesy. Bienvenido al mercado; your paperwork is complete.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam. You asked! How exceptionally civil. I shall remember this courtesy. Welcome to the market; your paperwork is complete.
lines.narrative: The archway’s visitors’ book flutters open at a page marked IMPORTANT COURTESIES. Portia clears a throat not included in her architectural plans and opens the passage.
